class.name: FillAccumulator
class.brief_description: Second-order inertial dwell / charge accumulator node for gaze UI interactions.
class.description:
Smoothly charges fill in [0.0, 1.0] toward 1.0 when target_error <= 0 (or active_target is true) and drains toward 0.0 when outside the target, accelerating rate changes via fill_acceleration and drain_acceleration and scaling drain acceleration with (1 + error / error_doubling_distance).
Configure fill_sec / drain_sec (or fill_rate / drain_rate) and choose automatic updates via process_callback (PROCESS_MANUAL, PROCESS_IDLE, or PROCESS_PHYSICS), or call process_error_delta() / process_dwell_delta() manually.
Signals emitted: fill_changed(fill: float), fill_started(), filled(), emptied().

method.name: set_fill
method.description: Sets the normalized fill level clamped to [0.0, 1.0].

method.name: get_fill
method.description: Returns the normalized fill level in [0.0, 1.0].

method.name: get_velocity
method.description: Returns the current fill rate-of-change velocity in fill units per second.

method.name: is_filled
method.description: Returns true when fill has reached 1.0.

method.name: is_empty
method.description: Returns true when fill is at 0.0.

method.name: set_fill_rate
method.description: Sets maximum charging rate in normalized fill units per second (default 1.6).

method.name: get_fill_rate
method.description: Returns maximum charging rate in normalized fill units per second.

method.name: set_drain_rate
method.description: Sets base draining rate in normalized fill units per second (default 2.0).

method.name: get_drain_rate
method.description: Returns base draining rate in normalized fill units per second.

method.name: set_fill_sec
method.description: Sets time in seconds to fill from 0.0 to 1.0 at max rate (inverse of fill_rate).

method.name: get_fill_sec
method.description: Returns time in seconds to fill from 0.0 to 1.0 at max rate.

method.name: set_drain_sec
method.description: Sets time in seconds to drain from 1.0 to 0.0 at base drain rate (inverse of drain_rate).

method.name: get_drain_sec
method.description: Returns time in seconds to drain from 1.0 to 0.0 at base drain rate.

method.name: set_fill_acceleration
method.description: Sets acceleration toward fill_rate in units/sec^2 (default 32.0).

method.name: get_fill_acceleration
method.description: Returns acceleration toward fill_rate in units/sec^2.

method.name: set_drain_acceleration
method.description: Sets deceleration / drain acceleration in units/sec^2 (default 32.0).

method.name: get_drain_acceleration
method.description: Returns drain acceleration in units/sec^2.

method.name: set_error_doubling_distance
method.description: Sets distance (px) at which positive target_error doubles drain acceleration (default 100.0).

method.name: get_error_doubling_distance
method.description: Returns error doubling distance in logical pixels.

method.name: set_process_callback
method.description: Sets automatic stepping mode (PROCESS_MANUAL, PROCESS_IDLE, or PROCESS_PHYSICS).

method.name: get_process_callback
method.description: Returns automatic stepping mode.

method.name: set_target_error
method.description: Sets signed target boundary distance in pixels (<= 0 charges, > 0 drains) used by automatic processing.

method.name: get_target_error
method.description: Returns signed target boundary distance in pixels.

method.name: set_active_target
method.description: Sets boolean dwell active flag used by automatic processing when true.

method.name: is_active_target_dwell
method.description: Returns whether automatic processing treats the dwell target as active.

method.name: process_error_delta
method.description:
Advances the accumulator for a single time step given signed boundary error.
p_error Signed distance outside target boundary in logical pixels (<= 0 fills, > 0 drains). p_delta Elapsed time in seconds.
Signed distance outside target boundary in logical pixels (<= 0 fills, > 0 drains).
Elapsed time in seconds.

method.name: process_dwell_delta
method.description:
Advances the accumulator for a single time step given boolean activation.
p_is_active True to charge toward 1.0, false to drain toward 0.0. p_delta Elapsed time in seconds.
True to charge toward 1.0, false to drain toward 0.0.
Elapsed time in seconds.

method.name: reset
method.description: Resets fill and velocity to 0.0 and emits emptied/fill_changed signals if state changed.
